Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: Always the first field in a FIX message. Valid value: FIX.4.2

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Always the second field in a FIX message. Length of message expressed as the number of characters following the BodyLength field up to and including the delimiter immediately preceding the CheckSum tag.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Always the third field in a FIX message. Defines the message type.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Message sequence number (numeric).

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Ignored.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: Identifies the party sending the message. The sending firm should use their Line Identifier as assigned by Sapphire. Sapphire will use "Sapphire" when sending messages to firms.

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Sub identifier of the party sending the message. Required for application messages sent from firm to Sapphire.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Time of message transmission in UTC. Must be within 60 seconds of the current time else the order will be rejected. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.uuu

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: Identifies the party receiving the message. Firms should use the value "Sapphire". Sapphire will use the firm's Line ID when sending messages to firms.

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Sub identifier of the party receiving the message. Required for application messages delivered to firms from Sapphire.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Ignored in messages sent to Sapphire. Set to Y in messages from Sapphire during certain failure/recovery scenarios.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: Only applicable to messages sent to Sapphire: identifies the end client that is the originator of the message. Returned in the DeliverToCompID of corresponding messages.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: Only applicable to messages sent to Sapphire: sub identifier of the end client. Returned in the DeliverToSubID of corresponding messages.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Required for resent messages. If no data is available, set to the SendingTime value. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.uuu

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: Only applicable to messages sent from Sapphire: Sapphire reflects back the data sent in OnBehalfOfCompID.

Field.Name: DeliverToSubID
Field.Description: Only applicable to messages sent from Sapphire: Sapphire reflects back the data sent in OnBehalfOfSubID.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Always the last field of a FIX message.

Field.Name: RawDataLength
Field.Description: The number of bytes in RawData. When used, must be set to 1. Omit tags 95 and 96 when Auto Cancel on Disconnect (ACOD) is not required.

Field.Name: RawData
Field.Description: Raw data of the length specified in RawDataLength. Valid values: "1" = Activate Auto Cancel on Disconnect (ACOD) on disconnect or graceful logout.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Always unencrypted.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Value specified in seconds. Must be greater than 0 and the same value must be used by both sides.

Field.Name: ResetSeqNumFlag
Field.Description: Indicates both sides of a FIX session should reset sequence numbers.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Required when the heartbeat is the result of a Test Request message.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Test request identifier to be returned in the resulting Heartbeat.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of first message in range to be resent.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of last message in range to be resent.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of rejected message.

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: Required if reject reason refers to a specific tag.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: The MsgType of the FIX message being referenced.

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for a session-level Reject message.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Supplied if there is a need to provide more information regarding the reject.

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: Indicates that this message is replacing administrative or application messages which will not be resent.

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: New sequence number.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Can be used to send readable information to the recipient. FOI will just log this.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Customer ID defined by the firms. Maximum length 10 characters. FOI will pass this through for clearing.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the order as assigned by the firm for the MPID used to populate SenderSubID. Must be 30 characters or less. Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day for an MPID regardless of FIX Session.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Valid values: f = Inter-market Sweep Order (ISO); o = Auto Cancel on connection loss (ACOD for this order). Any other value rejects the order.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of contracts specified on the order. Valid range: 1 to 999,999. Max length 6.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Valid values: 1 = Market, 2 = Limit.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price for limit orders (OrdType = 2). Standard OCC clearing format, combined total digits before and after the decimal is 8 or less (4 before, 4 after). Should not be specified on market orders.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order. Valid values: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: The 6 character OCC Security Symbol (Class) for an option.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Specifies how long the order remains in effect. Valid values: 0 = DAY, 3 = IOC (Immediate or Cancel).

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of execution/order creation expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated), also known as GMT. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.uuu

Field.Name: ExecBroker
Field.Description: Specifies order handling. Valid values: "DNR" = Do not route (Trade at Sapphire or post to Sapphire book. Never route away). Default: if this tag is absent, the order may be eligible for routing as per Sapphire routing rules.

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Specifies if this order opens or closes a position. Required except when CustomerOrFirm is 4 or 5. Valid values: O = Open, C = Close.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: Identifies type of instrument. Valid value: OPT.

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: Expiration month and year. Format: YYYYMM.

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: Indicates whether an option is a put or a call. Valid values: 0 = Put, 1 = Call.

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Strike price for an option.

Field.Name: CoveredOrUncovered
Field.Description: Specifies whether the option position is covered or uncovered. Valid values: 0 = Covered, 1 = Uncovered.

Field.Name: CustomerOrFirm
Field.Description: Specifies the order origin type. Valid values: 0 = Priority Customer, 1 = Firm, 2 = Broker/Dealer, 4 = Market Maker (MM), 5 = Non-Member Market Maker, 8 = Non-Priority Customer.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Expiration day of month, used with MaturityMonthYear (200) to fully specify the maturity date for options. Format: DD.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: CMTA information of Order originator's clearing firm. Valid range: 1 - 99999.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: OCC sub-account (Multi-account). This is a required value for Non-member MM orders. Sapphire Member MM can send their MPID in this tag in lieu of tag 109. It must be an UPPERCASE alphanumeric value, with a maximum of 5 characters. A value with up to 3 characters is generally used.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: For Sapphire member Market Maker orders, MMs can send their MPID with this tag. Sapphire Member MM can send in their MPID in tag 440 in lieu of tag 109.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Additional clearing information for the order that Sapphire will send to OCC. Max 13 characters.

Field.Name: MaxPriceLevels
Field.Description: MIAX Variable Protection (MVP). Unspecified = use default configured in Sapphire system. 0 = order eligible to trade only at its Initial Reference Price (IRP); 1 through 20 = maximum ticks (MPVs) beyond IRP before cancel back (capped to Sapphire maximum); greater than 20 = order rejected.

Field.Name: CrossID
Field.Description: Identifier for a cross order. Must be 30 characters or less. Sapphire recommends firms to maintain uniqueness across New Order Cross (MsgType = s) and New Order Cross - Multileg (MsgType = As) within a single trading day for the EEM across all FOIs for the firm.

Field.Name: CrossType
Field.Description: Valid values: 4 = Customer-to-Customer Cross (C2C), 6 = Qualified Contingent Cross (QCC).

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of contracts to cross. When CrossType (549)=6 (QCC), OrderQty must be minimum 1,000. Valid range: 1 to 999,999. Max length 6.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Valid values: 2 = Limit.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price for limit orders (OrdType = 2). Valid ranges published via Technical Circular.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: The 6 character OCC Security Symbol (Class) for an option.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of execution/order creation expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated), also known as GMT. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.uuu

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear

Field.Name: PutOrCall

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Strike price for an option.

Field.Name: MaturityDay

Field.Name: UnderlyingPrice
Field.Description: Execution price of the NMS stock trade associated with this QCC order. Max 11 bytes. Only relevant for QCC Order (549=6).

Field.Name: UnderlyingQty
Field.Description: Traded quantity of the NMS stock trade associated with this QCC order. Max 9 bytes. Only relevant for QCC Order (549=6).

Field.Name: PriceDelta
Field.Description: The delta of the NMS stock trade associated with the QCC order. Max 11 bytes. Only relevant for QCC Order (549=6).

Field.Name: UnderlyingExecutionTime
Field.Description: Time of execution of the NMS stock trade associated with this QCC order. Only relevant for QCC Order (549=6). Format: HH:MM:SS (EST).

Field.Name: UnderlyingExecutionExchange
Field.Description: Executing exchange of the NMS stock trade associated with this QCC order. Max 4 bytes. MIC code or Exchange code. Only relevant for QCC Order (549=6).

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Valid values: o = Auto Cancel on connection loss (ACOD for this order). Any other value rejects the order.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of strategies specified on the order. Valid range: must be positive. The absolute value of the highest Option Leg Ratio of the strategy multiplied by the OrderQty must be less or equal to 999,999. The absolute value of the Stock Leg Ratio of the strategy, if present, multiplied by the OrderQty must be less or equal to 99,999,999.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Valid values: 1 = Market (market order acceptance is set by the exchange; refer to Sapphire circulars for the current setting), 2 = Limit.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The net price of the spread. Required for Limit orders. To the customer that enters the order: Debit (positive) = willing to pay; Credit (negative) = wants cash back; 0 (zero) = even orders. Format is limited to max 4 decimal places for stock-tied orders and 2 decimal places for all other orders. Price should not be specified on market orders. Sapphire will not accept an order where a leg can print higher than max price for a simple order.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Specifies how long the order remains in effect. Valid values: 0 = DAY, 3 = IOC (Immediate or Cancel).

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of execution/order creation expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated), also known as GMT. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.uuu

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: Identifies type of instrument. Valid value: MLEG.

Field.Name: CustomerOrFirm
Field.Description: Specifies the order origin type. Valid values: 0 = Priority Customer, 1 = Firm, 2 = Broker/Dealer, 4 = Market Maker (MM), 5 = Non-Member Market Maker, 8 = Non-Priority Customer.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: CMTA information of Order originator's clearing firm. Valid range: 1 - 99999.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: OCC sub-account (Multi-account). This is a required value for Non-member MM orders. Sapphire Member MM can send their MPID in this tag in lieu of tag 109. It must be an UPPERCASE alphanumeric value, with a maximum of 5 characters. A value with up to 3 characters is generally used.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Stock leg only. Specifies firm's capacity for the stock leg. Valid values: A = Agency, P = Principal, R = Riskless Principal.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: For Sapphire member Market Maker orders, MMs can send their MPID with this tag. Sapphire Member MM can send in their MPID in tag 440 in lieu of tag 109.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Additional clearing information for the order that Sapphire will send to OCC. Max 13 characters.

Field.Name: MIAXExecInst
Field.Description: Sapphire specifies Execution Instructions. Valid values: P = ABBO Price Protection (APP). If any other value is present the order will be rejected.

Field.Name: StockClearingAccount
Field.Description: Stock-tied orders only. Underlying MPID or DTCC account for the Stock leg of this order.

Field.Name: CrossID
Field.Description: Identifier for a cross order. Must be 30 characters or less. Sapphire recommends firms to maintain uniqueness across New Order Cross (MsgType = s) and New Order Cross - Multileg (MsgType = As) within a single trading day for the EEM across all FOIs for the firm.

Field.Name: CrossType
Field.Description: Valid values: 4 = cC2C, 6 = cQCC.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Valid values: 2 = Limit. Market Orders not supported.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The net price of the spread from the perspective of the customer that originates the order (first order in the message): Debit (positive) = willing to pay; Credit (negative) = wants cash back; 0 (zero) = even orders. Up to 4 decimal places for stock-tied cQCC; 2 decimal places for all other orders including stock-tied cC2C.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of strategies to cross. When CrossType (549)=6 (cQCC), (OrderQty * min LegRatio) must be minimum 1000 or order will be rejected. Valid range: must be positive. The absolute value of the highest Option Leg Ratio of the strategy multiplied by the OrderQty must be less or equal to 999,999. The absolute value of the Stock Leg Ratio of the strategy, if present, multiplied by the OrderQty must be less or equal to 99,999,999.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of execution/order creation expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated), also known as GMT. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.uuu

Field.Name: UnderlyingPrice
Field.Description: Execution price of the NMS stock trade associated with this cQCC order. Max 11 bytes. Only relevant for cQCC Order (549=6).

Field.Name: UnderlyingQty
Field.Description: Traded quantity of the NMS stock trade associated with this cQCC order. Max 9 bytes. Only relevant for cQCC Order (549=6).

Field.Name: PriceDelta
Field.Description: The delta of the NMS stock trade associated with the cQCC order. Max 11 bytes. Only relevant for cQCC Order (549=6).

Field.Name: UnderlyingExecutionTime
Field.Description: Time of execution of the NMS stock trade associated with this cQCC order. Only relevant for cQCC Order (549=6). Format: HH:MM:SS (EST).

Field.Name: UnderlyingExecutionExchange
Field.Description: Executing exchange of the NMS stock trade associated with this cQCC order. Max 4 bytes. Can be MIC code or Exchange code. Only relevant for cQCC Order (549=6).

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the cancel request, assigned by the institution. Must be 30 characters or less.

Field.Name: RequestType
Field.Description: When absent, request is treated as a request for canceling a single order. Required for mass cancels. Valid values: 0 = Single order cancel; 31 = Mass cancel of all orders for this MPID on this Session only; 34 = Mass cancel of all orders for this MPID on this Session only and Security Symbol (class); 37 = Mass cancel of all orders for this Firm on this Session only. Default = “0” when not present.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Not required. No validation if the tag is present.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: RequestType>0: ignored. RequestType=0 or missing: required. ClOrdID of the targeted order to cancel. Must be 30 characters or less.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: RequestType>0: ignored. RequestType=0 or missing: required. Side of order. Must match the original order. Valid values: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell. Not required for multileg orders.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: Identifies type of instrument. Valid values: OPT (Options) - cancel only simple option orders; MLEG (Multileg) - cancel only multileg orders; ALL - cancel both simple and multileg orders. Default = "ALL" when not present in the Cancel Request. RequestType=31, 37: ignored. RequestType=34: required. RequestType=0 or missing: required.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: RequestType=31, 37: ignored. RequestType=34: required. RequestType=0 or missing: not required for multileg orders, else required. The 6 character OCC Security Symbol (class) for an option. This value must match the original order.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time request was initiated/released expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated), also known as GMT. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.uuu

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: RequestType>0: ignored. RequestType=0 or missing: required. Expiration month and year. Value must match the original order. Format: YYYYMM. Not required for multileg orders.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: RequestType>0: ignored. RequestType=0 or missing: required. Expiration day of month, used along with MaturityMonthYear (200) to fully specify the maturity date for options. Must match the original order. Format: DD (single digit allowed). Not required for multileg orders.

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: RequestType>0: ignored. RequestType=0 or missing: required. Specifies whether the option is a put or a call. Must match the original order. Valid values: 0 = Put, 1 = Call. Not required for multileg orders.

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: RequestType>0: ignored. RequestType=0 or missing: required. Strike price for an option, which must match the original order. Not required for multileg orders.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique ID of replacement order as assigned by the institution. Used in the ClOrdID field of the Cancel Reject message if the replacement request is rejected. Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day for an MPID regardless of FIX Session. Must be 30 characters or less.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: The total intended order quantity. Valid value: 1 - 999,999. Max length 6.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Order type of the replacement order. May be changed. Valid values: 1 = Market, 2 = Limit.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the targeted order when canceling or replacing an order.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price for limit orders (OrdType = 2). Format follows standard OCC clearing format where a combined total digits before and after the decimal is 8 or less (4 digits before the decimal can have 4 after). Valid range published via Technical Alert. Price should not be specified on market orders.

Field.Description: Side of order. Must match the original order. Valid values: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: The 6 character OCC Security Symbol (Class) for an option. Value must match original order.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Additional information about the order. Must be re-specified if it was on the original order and needs to be carried over.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Specifies how long the order remains in effect. TIF may not be replaced. Valid values: 0 = DAY.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time request was initiated/released expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated), also known as GMT. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.uuu

Field.Name: OpenClose

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: For Sapphire member Market Maker orders, MM can send their MPID. Must match original order. Sapphire Member MM can send their MPID in this tag in lieu of tag 440.

Field.Name: SecurityType

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: Expiration month and year. Value must match the original order. Format: YYYYMM.

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: Must match the original order. Valid values: 0 = Put, 1 = Call.

Field.Name: StrikePrice

Field.Name: CoveredOrUncovered
Field.Description: Specifies covered or uncovered options. If tag is absent, the value from target order is retained. Valid values: 0 = Covered, 1 = Uncovered.

Field.Name: CustomerOrFirm

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Expiration day of month, used along with MaturityMonthYear (200) to fully specify the maturity date for options. Format: DD (single digit allowed).

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: Clearing Member Transfer Agreement. Required if value was on the original order and needs to be carried over. Provides CMTA information. Valid range: 1 - 99999.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: OCC sub-account (Multi-account). This is a required value for Non-member MM orders. Must match original order. Sapphire Member MM can send their MPID in this tag in lieu of tag 109. It must be an UPPERCASE alphanumeric value, with a maximum of 5 characters. A value with up to 3 characters is generally used.

Field.Description: Unique identifier of the order as assigned by the firm for the MPID used to populate SenderSubID. Must be 30 characters or less. Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day for an MPID regardless of FIX Session.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: The total intended order quantity. Valid range: the absolute value of the highest Option Leg Ratio of the strategy multiplied by the OrderQty must be less or equal to 999,999. The absolute value of the Stock Leg Ratio of the strategy, if present, multiplied by the OrderQty must be less or equal to 99,999,999.

To the customer that enters the order: Debit (positive) = willing to pay; Credit (negative) = wants cash back; 0 (zero) = even orders. Price should not be specified on market orders. Same format as specified in the Complex order message.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Specifies how long the order remains in effect. TIF may not be replaced. Valid values: 0 = DAY.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time request was initiated/released expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated), also known as GMT. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.uuu

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: Identifies type of instrument. Valid value: MLEG.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Additional clearing information for the order that Sapphire will send to OCC. Max 13 characters.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique order ID assigned by institution to the cancel request or to the replacement order.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Status of order after the Cancel Reject function is applied.

Field.Description: Identifies the type of request that a Cancel Reject is in response to. Valid values: 1 = Order Cancel Request; 2 = Order Cancel/Replace Request.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: As specified on the order. Optional field.

Field.Name: CumQty

Field.Name: ExecTransType

Field.Description: Quantity of bought/sold contracts/shares on the last fill. Not required for ExecTransType = 3 (Status).

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: The number of option contracts or stock shares.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Identifies the current status of an order. Valid values: 0 = New, 1 = Partially Filled, 2 = Filled, 3 = Done for day, 4 = Canceled, 5 = Replaced, 6 = Pending Cancel, 8 = Rejected.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Order type that is specified on the order. Valid values: 1 = Market, 2 = Limit.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the canceled or replaced order. This is the target order of the previous request and not the initial order of the day.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price for limit orders (OrdType = 2). Format follows Price field as described in MsgType D, s, AB, As, G and AC.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order. Valid values: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell, 5 = Sell Short (stock leg), 6 = Sell Short Exempt (stock leg).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: For Option Legs: the 6 character OCC Security Symbol (class) for an option. For Equity Legs: the OCC Options underlying symbol (default) or stock ticker symbol (configurable).

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Reject Reports (ExecType = 8) contain text describing error specified in Appendix C: Error Code table, format 'Error Code': 'Description'. User requested Cancel and Replace with ExecType equal to "6" contain partial Canceled Quantity, format CxlQty: 'value'. Unsolicited Canceled (ExecType = 4) will contain a freeform human readable reason for the cancel.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Specifies how long the order remains in effect. Valid values: 0 = DAY, 3 = IOC (Immediate or Cancel).

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of execution/order creation expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated), also known as GMT. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.uuu

Field.Name: ExecBroker
Field.Description: Specifies order handling. Valid values: "DNR" = Do not route (Trade at Sapphire or post to Sapphire book. Never route away). Default: if this tag is absent, the order may be eligible for routing as per Sapphire routing rules.

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Option leg only. Specifies if this order opens a position or closes a position. Required except for Sapphire member or Non-Member Market Maker orders. Valid values: O = Open, C = Close.

Field.Name: OrdRejReason
Field.Description: The reason the order was rejected. Valid values: 0 = Broker Option, 1 = Unknown Symbol, 2 = Exchange Closed, 3 = Order Exceeds Limit, 4 = Too Late to Enter, 5 = Unknown Order, 6 = Duplicate Order, 8 = Stale Order, 11 = Unsupported Order Characteristic.

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Identifies the type of execution report. Valid values: 0 = New, 1 = Partially filled, 2 = Filled, 3 = Done for day, 4 = Canceled, 5 = Replaced, 6 = Pending Cancel, 8 = Rejected.

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Number of open contracts/shares for further execution. If the OrdStatus is Canceled or Rejected (no longer active) then LeavesQty = 0, otherwise LeavesQty = OrderQty - CumQty, or LeavesQty = OrderQty * LegRatio - CumQty.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: The type of security. Valid values: OPT or MLEG.

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: Option leg only. Expiration month and year, as specified on the order. Format: YYYYMM.

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: Option leg only. As specified on the order. Valid values: 0 = Put, 1 = Call.

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Option leg only. Strike price for an option, as specified on the order.

Field.Name: CustomerOrFirm
Field.Description: Option leg only. Specifies the order origin type that is specified on the order. Valid values: 0 = Priority Customer, 1 = Firm, 2 = Broker/Dealer, 4 = Market Maker, 5 = Non-Member Market Maker, 8 = Non-Priority Customer.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Option leg only. Expiration day of month, used along with MaturityMonthYear (200) to fully specify the maturity date for options. Format: DD.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Option leg only. Exchange ID (MIC code) of the Exchange on which this execution occurred when it occurs on an exchange other than Sapphire.

Field.Name: MultiLegReportingType
Field.Description: Used to indicate what an Execution Report represents for Multileg orders only. Valid values: 2 = Individual Leg of a Multileg Security; 3 = Multileg Security.

Field.Name: CFICode
Field.Description: CFI code for the individual leg. Valid values: ES = Equity Shares. Presently only for Multileg equity leg.

Field.Name: IndividualAllocID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for a specific NoAllocs repeating group used in a cross order.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Stock leg only. Firm's capacity for the stock leg as specified in the order. Valid values: A = Agency, P = Principal, R = Riskless Principal.

Field.Name: CrossID
Field.Description: Identification from a cross order. Only populated from New Order Cross or New Order Cross - Multileg orders.

Field.Name: LegRefID
Field.Description: Identifier from the original order. Only present when tag 442 set to 2.

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: The unique ID that identifies the trade at Sapphire. Only available on Fill (ExecType 1 or 2) messages.

Field.Name: MIAXExecInst
Field.Description: Instructions for order handling on exchange. Will be the same value as entered in the order (if used). Valid values: P = ABBO Price Protection (APP).

Field.Name: StockExecutionDestination
Field.Description: Stock leg only. Stock trading/reporting venue that will report and clear the stock leg trade. Valid values: 1 = NASDAQ TRF.

Field.Name: AdditionalBillingParameters
Field.Description: For Order Executions (ExecType=1 or 2): a field containing additional (not contained elsewhere in Execution Report or Order) parameters required for Sapphire billing. See Appendix D: Additional Billing Parameters. For other Execution Reports (ExecType is not 1 or 2): tag will not be sent.

Field.Name: FirmMPID
Field.Description: Only present if execution report is for a fill or partial fill resulting from a New Order Cross message.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: The ClOrdID of the order being requested. Must be 30 characters or less.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Order side, which must match the original order for simple orders. Valid values: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell. Not required for Complex Orders.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: The 6 character OCC Security Symbol (Class) for an option.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: Valid value: OPT or MLEG.

Field.Name: UserStatus
Field.Description: User status.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of event creation expressed in UTC.

Field.Name: MPIDGroupID
Field.Description: Firm assigned Group ID. Alphanumeric, max length 32.

Field.Name: MetricID
Field.Description: Metric ID for the group. Alphanumeric, max length 32.

Field.Name: RoutingID
Field.Description: Firm assigned Routing ID. Alphanumeric, max length 32.

Field.Name: MetricType
Field.Description: Valid values: C = Rate of Executed Order Contracts; O = Rate of New/Replace Orders Received.

Field.Name: EventType
Field.Description: Determines the reason for the notification. Valid values: S = Period Status/Pulse Notification; T = Safeguard Trigger; R = Reset Risk Metric; W = Warning Only; D = Metric Deleted; A = Metric Added; P = Metric Paused; U = Metric Un-Paused.

Field.Name: MessageID
Field.Description: Unique ID assigned by Sapphire for this event. Can be used to order solicited messages. Unsolicited messages have a value of zero (0).

Field.Name: ConfiguredCountingTimePeriod
Field.Description: Configured time period in milliseconds used to consider events for this Metric ID.

Field.Name: ConfiguredMaxQuantity
Field.Description: Configured max threshold of counted items for the configured counting time interval for this Metric ID.

Field.Name: CurrentQuantity
Field.Description: Current counted quantity at the time of the event for this Metric ID.

Field.Name: MaxPeakQuantity
Field.Description: Max peak for Current Quantity during pulse interval.

Field.Name: PercentageLevel
Field.Description: Current percentage for the counted quantity in relationship to Configured Max Quantity. Valid values 0 to 255%.

Field.Name: ProtectionType
Field.Description: Valid values: B = Block all MPIDs for this MPID Group ID; M = Block all MPIDs and mass-cancel all day orders; W = Warning only.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of rejected message.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: MsgType of the FIX message being rejected.

Field.Name: BusinessRejectRefID
Field.Description: Ref ID of the message being rejected. ExecID if an Execution Report is being rejected, ClOrdID if an Order/Cancel message, CrossID if a New Order Cross.

Field.Name: BusinessRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for Business rejection. Valid values: 0 = Other, 1 = Unknown ID, 2 = Unknown Security, 3 = Unsupported Message Type, 4 = System not available, 5 = Required or conditional tag missing, 6 = Matching engine for this symbol is not available.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Required if BusinessRejectReason = 0.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order. Valid values: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell. Required tag to start each repeated group.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the order as assigned by the firm for the MPID used to populate SenderSubID. Must be 30 characters or less. Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day for an MPID regardless of FIX Session.

Field.Name: AllocQty
Field.Description: Quantity to be allocated to specific sub-account. Valid range: 1 to 999,999. Max length 6. Required tag to start each repeated group.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Customer ID defined by the firms. Maximum length 10 characters. FOI will pass this through for clearing.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Additional clearing information for the order that Sapphire will send to OCC. Max 13 characters.

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Specifies if this order opens a position or closes a position. Required except when CustomerOrFirm set to 4 = Market Maker or 5 = Non-Member Market Maker. Valid values: O = Open, C = Close.

Field.Name: CustomerOrFirm
Field.Description: Specifies the order origin type. When CrossType (549)=4 (C2C): 0 = Priority Customer (other values will be rejected). When CrossType (549)=6 (QCC), Agency and Contra Side: 0 = Priority Customer, 1 = Firm, 2 = Broker/Dealer, 4 = Market Maker (MM), 5 = Non-Member Market Maker, 8 = Non-Priority Customer.

Field.Name: CoveredOrUncovered
Field.Description: Specifies whether the option position is covered or uncovered. Valid values: 0 = Covered, 1 = Uncovered.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: CMTA information of Order originator's clearing firm. Valid range: 1 - 99999.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: OCC sub-account (Multi-account). This is a required value for Non-member MM orders. Sapphire Member MM can send their MPID in this tag. It must be an UPPERCASE alphanumeric value, with a maximum of 5 characters. A value with up to 3 characters is generally used. Tag 109 is not available as in MsgType D.

Field.Name: IndividualAllocID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for a specific NoAllocs repeating group instance. Only validated for Contra Order when NoAlloc > 1. Uniqueness is for this order only. Not validated across orders. AlphaNumeric, max length 4.

Field.Name: FirmMPID
Field.Description: Executing Broker MPID (Firm MPID).

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the order as assigned by the firm for the MPID used to populate SenderSubID. Must be 30 characters or less. Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day for an MPID regardless of FIX Session. Required tag to start each repeated group.

Field.Name: AllocQty
Field.Description: Quantity to be allocated to specific sub-account. Valid range: 1 to 999,999. Max length 6. Required tag to start each Repeating Group.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Customer ID defined by the firms. Max length 10 characters. FOI will pass this through for clearing.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Additional clearing information for the order that Sapphire will send to OCC. Max 13 characters.

Field.Name: CustomerOrFirm
Field.Description: Specifies the order origin type. When CrossType (549)=4 (cC2C): 0 = Priority Customer. When CrossType (549)=6 (cQCC), Agency and Contra Side: 0 = Priority Customer, 1 = Firm, 2 = Broker/Dealer, 4 = Market Maker (MM), 5 = Non-Member Market Maker, 8 = Non-Priority Customer.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: CMTA information of Order originator's clearing firm. Valid range: 1 - 99999.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: OCC sub-account (Multi-account). This is a required value for Non-member MM orders. Sapphire Member MM can send their MPID in this tag. It must be an UPPERCASE alphanumeric value, with a maximum of 5 characters. A value with up to 3 characters is generally used. Tag 109 is not available as in MsgType D.

Field.Name: IndividualAllocID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for a specific NoAllocs repeating group instance. Only validated for Contra Order when NoAlloc > 1 (future phase), otherwise ignored. Uniqueness is for this order only. No validation across orders. AlphaNumeric, max length 4.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Required for stock-tied orders only. Specifies firm's capacity for the stock leg. Valid values: A = Agency, P = Principal, R = Riskless Principal.

Field.Name: StockClearingAccount
Field.Description: Stock-tied Orders only. Underlying MPID or DTCC account for the Stock leg of this order.

Field.Name: FirmMPID
Field.Description: Executing Broker MPID (Firm MPID).

Field.Name: LegSymbol
Field.Description: For Option Leg: the 6 character OCC Security Symbol (Class) for an option. For Stock Leg: the OCC Options underlying symbol (default) or stock ticker symbol (configurable). This field is used to delimit the repeating group.

Field.Name: LegCFICode
Field.Description: CFI code for the individual leg. Valid values: OC = Option call, OP = Option put, ES = Equity Shares.

Field.Name: LegMaturityDate
Field.Description: Option leg only. Expiration Date in the YYYYMMDD format.

Field.Name: LegStrikePrice
Field.Description: Option leg only. Strike price for an option.

Field.Name: LegRatioQty
Field.Description: The ratio of this individual leg. Number of option contracts or stock shares for this leg is: LegRatioQty * OrderQty. Valid range: for Option leg 1-99,999; for Stock leg 1-9,999,999. The absolute value of the highest Option Leg Ratio of the strategy multiplied by the OrderQty must be less or equal to 999,999. The absolute value of the Stock Leg Ratio of the strategy, if present, multiplied by the OrderQty must be less or equal to 99,999,999.

Field.Name: LegSide
Field.Description: The side of this individual leg. Valid values: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell, 5 = Sell Short (stock leg), 6 = Sell Short Exempt (stock leg).

Field.Name: LegRefID
Field.Description: Used to identify a specific leg. Firm assigned ID must not exceed 5 characters.

Field.Name: LegPositionEffect
Field.Description: Option leg only. Valid values: O = Open, C = Close.

Field.Name: LegCoveredOrUncovered
Field.Description: Option leg only. Specifies whether the option position is covered or uncovered. Valid values: 0 = Covered, 1 = Uncovered.

Field.Name: LegSymbol

Field.Name: LegCFICode

Valid range: for Option leg 1-99,999; for Stock leg 1-9,999,999. The absolute value of the highest Option Leg Ratio of the strategy multiplied by the OrderQty must be less or equal to 999,999. The absolute value of the Stock Leg Ratio of the strategy, if present, multiplied by the OrderQty must be less or equal to 99,999,999.

Field.Name: LegSide
Field.Description: The side of this leg from Agency Side. Valid values: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell, 5 = Sell Short (stock leg), 6 = Sell Short Exempt (stock leg).

Field.Name: ContraSideShortSell
Field.Description: Stock leg only. Required when this leg is stock leg and Contra Side of the stock leg is sell side, i.e., LegSide (624) = 1 (Buy). Specifies if it is a short sell. Valid values: 5 = Sell Short, 6 = Sell Short Exempt, n = Not a short sell.

Field.Name: LegRefID
Field.Description: Used to identify a specific leg. Firm assigned ID must not exceed 5 characters.

Field.Name: LegPositionEffect
Field.Description: Option leg only. Specifies if the order opens or closes a position on this leg for Agency Side. Required except when Agency side CustomerOrFirm set to 4 (Market Maker) or 5 (Non-Member Market Maker). Valid values: O = Open, C = Close.

Field.Name: ContraLegPositionEffect
Field.Description: Option leg only. Specifies if the order opens or closes a position on this leg for Contra Side. Required except when Contra side CustomerOrFirm set to 4 (Market Maker) or 5 (Non-Member Market Maker). Valid values: O = Open, C = Close.

Field.Name: LegCoveredOrUncovered
Field.Description: Option leg only. Specifies whether the Agency Side option position is covered or uncovered. Valid values: 0 = Covered, 1 = Uncovered.

Field.Name: ContraLegCoveredOrUncovered
Field.Description: Option leg only. Specifies whether the Contra Side option position is covered or uncovered. Valid values: 0 = Covered, 1 = Uncovered.
